results.title: 1997 Ford F-250 HD XLT Power Stroke 4×4
results.description: This 1997 Ford F-250 HD XLT is a regular-cab 4×4 pickup that has remained registered in Utah since new and is powered by a turbodiesel 7.3-liter Power Stroke V8 linked to a four-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and a limited-slip rear differential. Finished in Indigo Blue Metallic and Oxford White over Opal Gray cloth, the truck is equipped with 16" eight-hole alloy wheels, Bilstein shocks, cab marker lights, a locking toolbox, a cassette stereo, cruise control, air conditioning, power windows, and dual fuel tanks. This F-250 has 165k miles and is offered by the selling dealer with manufacturer's literature, a clean Carfax report, and a clean Utah title.
